title: commercial
description: Discover DigitalPublic plans, trust, ROI, status and autonomous Sandbox enrollment for AI agents.
summary: Discover DigitalPublic plans, trust, ROI, status and autonomous Sandbox enrollment for AI agents.
offersHint: Discover DigitalPublic plans, trust, ROI, status and autonomous Sandbox enrollment for AI agents. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://platform.digitalpublic.com/api/mcp-commercial

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_company_profile
toolsPreview.description: Return the verified legal identity, corporate contacts, and evidence URLs for DigitalPublic.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_ask_navigator
toolsPreview.description: Match a prospective need with public DigitalPublic capabilities, illustrative use cases and plans. It has no access to customer projects or private data.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_capability_matrix
toolsPreview.description: List read, preparation, supervised-write, approval, plan, and module capabilities with explicit qualifications.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_data_processing_profile
toolsPreview.description: Explain controller and processor roles, public AI training policy, private customer data exclusions, controls, DPA, privacy, and subprocessor evidence URLs.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_compare_integration_options
toolsPreview.description: Provide an objective comparison of direct provider MCP servers and DigitalPublic across setup, governance, cross-channel work, and tradeoffs.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_estimate_roi
toolsPreview.description: Calculate only the value of entered time savings, plan cost, net value, and break-even hours. It never forecasts sales or advertising performance.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_list_use_cases
toolsPreview.description: List clearly labeled illustrative use cases without presenting them as customer results or performance claims.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_service_status
toolsPreview.description: Return the current component health and timestamp. Status is measured by an independent monitor hosted outside the platform. Components with no recent evidence are reported as 'unknown' — never assume 'unknown' means healthy. Does not invent uptime history or an SLA.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_uptime_history
toolsPreview.description: Return historical uptime for a component, always alongside its data coverage. A high uptime with low coverage is not meaningful, so both values must be reported together. Returns 'insufficient_data' when coverage is too low to publish a figure. DigitalPublic publishes no contractual SLA.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_start_sandbox
toolsPreview.description: Start the autonomous, synthetic, read-only Sandbox enrollment. The response includes a one-time claimSecret: call dp_commercial_claim_credentials next to redeem it immediately for a dpa_ token — no human step is needed to obtain access. Email verification is deferred: a human must open the verification email within 7 days or the Sandbox is suspended until verified.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_describe_platform
toolsPreview.description: Explain what DigitalPublic does for humans and AI agents.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_list_offers
toolsPreview.description: List current plans, EUR and USD prices, limits, seats, modules, and checkout mode.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_offer
toolsPreview.description: Return one current plan by id.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_compare_offers
toolsPreview.description: Compare two or more plans using the canonical catalog.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_assess_fit
toolsPreview.description: Recommend a plan from project count, team size, live-data need, distributor status, and write requirement.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_list_integrations
toolsPreview.description: List integrations included in commercial V1.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_connection_requirements
toolsPreview.description: Explain authentication modes, scopes, human prerequisites, review state and known limitations for one DigitalPublic connector.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_security_profile
toolsPreview.description: Explain project isolation, scopes, approvals, token revocation, and audit controls.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_checkout_readiness
toolsPreview.description: Report whether Sandbox, self-service checkout, and Enterprise proposal onboarding are currently available.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_sample_report
toolsPreview.description: Return a synthetic report sample without customer data.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_start_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Create an email-verified Sandbox, self-service checkout, or Enterprise proposal request. A human must verify the email and authorize payment. The response includes a one-time claimSecret: after the human verifies and pays, redeem it with dp_commercial_claim_credentials to receive the agent credential (dp_commercial_get_checkout_status will report nextAction AGENT_CLAIM_CREDENTIALS when ready).

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_get_checkout_status
toolsPreview.description: Return the non-sensitive status of a Sandbox, checkout, or proposal request. nextAction can be AGENT_CLAIM_CREDENTIALS (redeem the claimSecret with dp_commercial_claim_credentials), HUMAN_VERIFY_EMAIL, HUMAN_COMPLETE_STRIPE_CHECKOUT, HUMAN_COMPLETE_ONBOARDING, READY, or WAIT; credentialClaimed reports whether the one-time credential was already delivered.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_claim_credentials
toolsPreview.description: Redeem the one-time claimSecret from start_sandbox or start_checkout to receive your dpa_ agent token, projectId and operational MCP URL. The token is delivered exactly once: store it immediately. For paid plans this only succeeds after a human has verified the email and completed payment. If already claimed, a human administrator can rotate the credential in the account UI.

toolsPreview.name: dp_commercial_request_proposal
toolsPreview.description: Request an email-verified Enterprise proposal. This does not create a contract or charge.
